ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram of the food web shown, the plant-feeding nematodes get their energy source from?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram, there is a box labeled “Shoots / Roots” in the upper left, and a box labeled “Plant-feeding Nematodes” near the right side. From the “Shoots / Roots” box there is an arrow pointing to the “Plant-feeding Nematodes” box. Reasoning: Arrows in a food web indicate that energy or food sources flow to the organisms that obtain energy. Therefore, the energy source of Plant-feeding Nematodes is Shoots and Roots.
